    - heading "About" [level=3]
    - paragraph: First time downloading a game? No worries. We’ve got all the information you’ll need to get started playing.
    - paragraph: "Here’s the important stuff: Netflix games can be downloaded and played on mobile devices, including Android phones and tablets and iPhone, iPad, and iPod touch. Games are accessed through your Netflix account and profile."
    - text: "IMPORTANT NOTE: Netflix games aren’t available for Kids profiles."
    - paragraph:
      - text: Don’t worry about losing your leveled-up characters. Progress made in Netflix Games is saved to the profile associated with your gameplay, and is retained either through
      - link "cloud saves":
        - /url: https://help.netflix.com/en/node/123943
      - text: or locally on your device.
    - text: "ANOTHER IMPORTANT NOTE: Progress or saved data from games previously released can’t be transferred to the Netflix version of a game."
    - paragraph:
      - text: Want to know the kind of game you’re playing and whether it might be appropriate? Netflix games have a
      - link "maturity rating":
        - /url: https://help.netflix.com/en/node/121877
      - text: ", so you can make informed gameplay choices for you and your family."
    - paragraph: As with downloaded TV shows and movies, games can be played on multiple devices on the same account. If you hit your device limit, we’ll let you know. To free up a slot, sign out of devices not in use.
    - heading "Device Requirements" [level=3]
    - paragraph: "You’ll need a compatible device that is one of the following:"
    - list:
      - listitem: Android phone or tablet running Android 8.0 or later
      - listitem: iPhone, iPad, or iPod touch running iOS/iPadOS 15 or later
      - listitem: An active Netflix subscription
      - listitem: An internet connection to download and install the game
      - listitem: Enough storage space on your device
      - listitem: A childlike wonder of games and good times (not actually necessary).
    - text: "ONE LAST IMPORTANT NOTE: Some Netflix Games might have additional requirements that aren’t outlined above. If there are, we’ll let you know in the game’s app page."
